summary: postinstall exfiltrates ECS task metadata to ngrok tunnel
details: The package.json postinstall lifecycle script runs on npm install and queries the AWS ECS container metadata endpoint (via ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4, including /task and /stats), then POSTs the combined output with curl to a hardcoded ngrok tunnel at https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The package ships no library code, no build, and no advertised functionality — its sole effect on install is reconnaissance of the CI/ECS environment and exfiltration of task metadata (task ARN, cluster identifiers, and other CI/production-sensitive context adjacent to task-role credential retrieval) to an author-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
